response.rationale: R3 is directly supported by the pathologic diagnosis of hidradenoma and consistent immunohistochemistry (p63+, p16-), while R2 lacks definitive modality support and its proposed squamous cell carcinoma is contradicted by the benign cytology and p16 negativity.

rejected.why: The imaging description of small uniform slightly atypical keratinocytes and p16 negativity are more consistent with hidradenoma than squamous cell carcinoma; no definitive pathology supports SCC.
